"""Independent arithmetic/hash review of retained data; imports no SharpForge code and launches no qualification."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import math
import subprocess

BASE = Path('/workspace/scratch/7e3d2a445c44')
DATA = BASE / 'project6-pe-bounds-performance.integration-f009'
EXECUTION = BASE / 'project6-pe-bounds-execution.integration-f009'
CANDIDATE = BASE / 'sf6-pe-bounds'
NATIVE = CANDIDATE / 'tests/fixtures/pe-bounds/reference-integration-f009'
PRODUCT = '8f0f0feec8ed8955e6119a346051ec6fdd965760'
QUALIFIED = '74559c16430dbf50778afe96d3c19a7cc3ade8e4'
HEAD = 'ddf3da105ace61ed61463a5704caf93c0c3dcf6f'
BASELINE = 'f009e2949f3311f0ca84a4a6bc694535140d130b'


def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def identity(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(path), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': digest(data)}


def git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root, text=True).strip()


def milliseconds(value):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z', '+00:00')).timestamp() * 1000


def distribution(values):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    count = len(ordered)
    assert count == 100
    return {'count': count, 'median': (ordered[49] + ordered[50]) / 2,
            'p95': ordered[94], 'p99': ordered[98], 'min': ordered[0], 'max': ordered[-1]}


def compare_numbers(actual, expected):
    assert actual.keys() == expected.keys()
    for name in actual:
        assert math.isclose(actual[name], expected[name], rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-12), (name, actual[name], expected[name])


report = load(DATA / 'report.json')
receipt = load(EXECUTION / 'performance.execution.json')
assert report['status'] == 'completed' and report['harnessCommit'] == HEAD
assert report['revisions'] == {'baselineCommit': BASELINE, 'productCommit': PRODUCT, 'nativeReference': str(NATIVE)}
assert receipt['status'] == 'passed' and receipt['exitCode'] == 0 and receipt['signal'] is None
assert receipt['interruptions'] == receipt['inspectionErrors'] == [] and receipt['sourcesUnchanged'] is True
assert receipt['sourceBefore'] == receipt['sourceAfter']
assert receipt['sourceAfter']['head'] == HEAD and receipt['sourceAfter']['status'] == ''
assert receipt['sourceAfter']['productChangedPaths'] == []
assert receipt['sourceAfter']['trackedChangedPaths'] == receipt['sourceAfter']['stagedChangedPaths'] == []
assert receipt['sourceAfter']['untrackedPaths'] == []
assert receipt['sourceAfter']['inspectionErrors'] == []
for path, expected in receipt['sourceAfter']['files'].items():
    assert digest((CANDIDATE / path).read_bytes()) == expected, path
for name, value in receipt['sourceAfter']['aliases'].items():
    assert value['owned'] and str((CANDIDATE / 'node_modules/@sharpforge' / name).resolve()) == value['target']
assert git(CANDIDATE, 'status', '--porcelain=v1') == ''
assert git(CANDIDATE, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == HEAD
assert git(CANDIDATE, 'diff', '--name-only', PRODUCT, HEAD, '--', ':(glob)packages/*/src/**',
           ':(glob)packages/*/package.json', 'package.json') == ''
source_file_counts = {}
for side, source in report['sources'].items():
    root = Path(source['root'])
    assert git(root, 'status', '--porcelain=v1') == ''
    assert git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == source['head'] == (HEAD if side == 'candidate' else BASELINE)
    source_file_counts[side] = 0
    for package in source['packages']:
        assert Path(package['entry']) == root / 'packages' / package['name'] / 'src/index.js'
        assert (root / 'node_modules/@sharpforge' / package['name']).resolve() == root / 'packages' / package['name']
        tree = git(root, 'rev-parse', source['head'] + ':packages/' + package['name'] + '/src')
        assert tree == package['sourceTree']
        for path, expected in package['files'].items():
            assert digest((root / path).read_bytes()) == expected, path
        encoded = json.dumps(package['files'], separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode()
        assert digest(encoded) == package['sha256']
        source_file_counts[side] += len(package['files'])
for path, expected in report['tools'].items():
    assert digest((CANDIDATE / path).read_bytes()) == expected, path
for row in report['inputs']:
    actual = identity(Path(row['path']))
    assert actual['bytes'] == row['bytes'] and actual['sha256'] == row['sha256']

workloads = [('small', 128), ('dense96', 32), ('il', 64), ('r2r', 25), ('mixed', 25)]
expected_order = ['prepare-baseline', 'prepare-candidate']
for index, (name, _) in enumerate(workloads):
    expected_order += [name + '-' + side for side in (['baseline', 'candidate'] if index % 2 == 0 else ['candidate', 'baseline'])]
assert [row['label'] for row in report['commands']] == expected_order
raw_reports = {}
chronological = []
computed = {}
heap = {}
process_order = []
prior_finished = None
for command in report['commands']:
    label = command['label']
    job_path = DATA / (label + '.job.json')
    worker_path = DATA / (label + '.result.json')
    job = load(job_path)
    worker = load(worker_path)
    assert digest(job_path.read_bytes()) == command['jobSha256'] == worker['jobSha256']
    assert digest(worker_path.read_bytes()) == command['workerSha256']
    assert worker == command['worker'] and worker['status'] == 'passed'
    assert command['result']['exitCode'] == 0 and command['result']['signal'] is None
    assert worker['source'] == job['source'] == report['sources'][job['side']]
    assert job['harnessCommit'] == HEAD and job['tools'] == report['tools'] and job['inputs'] == report['inputs']
    assert job['revisions'] == {'baselineCommit': BASELINE, 'productCommit': PRODUCT}
    assert command['cwd'] == job['root'] == report['sources'][job['side']]['root']
    assert Path(command['argv'][1]) == CANDIDATE / 'packages/cil/tools/pe-bounds-benchmark-worker.mjs'
    assert command['argv'][2:] == ['--job', str(job_path)]
    assert command['startedAt'] <= worker['startedAt'] <= worker['finishedAt'] <= command['finishedAt']
    if prior_finished is not None:
        assert prior_finished <= command['startedAt'], 'Overlapping serial children'
    prior_finished = command['finishedAt']
    for stream in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
        data = (DATA / (label + '.' + stream + '.log')).read_bytes()
        assert digest(data) == command[stream + 'Sha256']
        assert data.decode() == command['result'][stream]
        if stream == 'stderr':
            assert data == b''
        else:
            assert json.loads(data) == {'status': 'passed'}
    process_order.append({'label': label, 'startedAt': command['startedAt'], 'finishedAt': command['finishedAt'],
                          'exitCode': 0, 'signal': None, 'jobSha256': command['jobSha256'],
                          'workerSha256': command['workerSha256']})
    raw_reports[label] = worker
    assert worker['facts'] == report['commands'][0]['worker']['facts']
    if job['mode'] == 'prepare':
        assert worker['samples'] == worker['warmups'] == worker['chronologicalSamples'] == []
        continue
    assert job['mode'] == 'measure'
    operations = dict(workloads)[job['workload']]
    assert worker['operationsPerBatch'] == operations
    assert job['expected'] == worker['facts'][job['workload']]
    assert len(worker['warmups']) == 20 and len(worker['samples']) == 100
    assert worker['chronologicalSamples'] == worker['warmups'] + worker['samples']
    prior_sample_end = None
    for index, sample in enumerate(worker['chronologicalSamples']):
        assert sample['sequence'] == index
        assert sample['phase'] == ('warmup' if index < 20 else 'measured')
        assert sample['batch'] == (index if index < 20 else index - 20)
        assert sample['operations'] == operations and sample['guard'] == 'passed'
        assert math.isfinite(sample['elapsedMs']) and sample['elapsedMs'] >= 0
        assert sample['microsecondsPerOperation'] == sample['elapsedMs'] * 1000 / operations
        assert isinstance(sample['netHeapBytes'], int)
        start, end = sample['startedAtMilliseconds'], sample['startedAtMilliseconds'] + sample['elapsedMs']
        assert milliseconds(command['startedAt']) <= start <= end <= milliseconds(command['finishedAt']) + 1
        if prior_sample_end is not None:
            assert start >= prior_sample_end - 0.001
        prior_sample_end = end
        chronological.append({**sample, 'child': label, 'childSequence': index, 'sequence': len(chronological)})
    computed[label] = distribution([row['elapsedMs'] * 1000 / operations for row in worker['samples']])
    compare_numbers(computed[label], worker['statistics'])
    signed = sorted(row['netHeapBytes'] for row in worker['samples'])
    heap[label] = {'measuredBatchNetBytes': distribution(signed), 'sumMeasuredNetBytes': sum(signed),
                   'meanMeasuredNetBytes': sum(signed) / len(signed),
                   'negativeMeasuredBatches': sum(value < 0 for value in signed),
                   'zeroMeasuredBatches': sum(value == 0 for value in signed),
                   'sumWarmupNetBytes': sum(row['netHeapBytes'] for row in worker['warmups']),
                   'sumAllNetBytes': sum(row['netHeapBytes'] for row in worker['chronologicalSamples'])}
assert report['chronologicalSamples'] == chronological and len(chronological) == 1200
assert sum(row['operations'] for row in chronological) == 65760
assert sum(row['operations'] for row in chronological if row['phase'] == 'measured') == 54800
assert sum(row['operations'] for row in chronological if row['phase'] == 'warmup') == 10960
comparisons = []
adverse = []
for index, (name, operations) in enumerate(workloads):
    before, after = computed[name + '-baseline'], computed[name + '-candidate']
    stored = report['comparisons'][index]
    assert stored['id'] == name
    compare_numbers(before, stored['results']['baseline'])
    compare_numbers(after, stored['results']['candidate'])
    changes = {}
    for metric in ['median', 'p95', 'p99', 'min', 'max']:
        delta = after[metric] - before[metric]
        percent = (after[metric] / before[metric] - 1) * 100
        changes[metric] = {'baseline': before[metric], 'candidate': after[metric],
                           'deltaMicrosecondsPerOperation': delta, 'percent': percent}
        if delta > 0:
            adverse.append({'workload': name, 'metric': metric, **changes[metric]})
        if metric in ['median', 'p95', 'p99']:
            assert math.isclose(percent, stored['changePercent'][metric], rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-12)
    comparisons.append({'workload': name, 'operationsPerBatch': operations, 'statistics': changes})

native = load(NATIVE / 'native.json')
assert digest((NATIVE / 'native.json').read_bytes()) == report['native']['sha256']
assert native['status'] == 'completed' and native['sourceCommit'] == QUALIFIED == report['native']['sourceCommit']
assert len(native['authored']) == 58 and len(native['references']) == 3
assert native['toolchain']['sdk'] == '10.0.201' and native['toolchain']['runtime'] == '10.0.5'
for path, expected in native['sourceSha256'].items():
    assert digest((CANDIDATE / path).read_bytes()) == expected, path
assert [row['label'] for row in native['commands']] == [
    'build-BoundsObserver', 'observe-authored', 'build-PEObserver', 'observe-il', 'observe-r2r', 'observe-mixed']
for command in native['commands']:
    assert command['result']['exitCode'] == 0 and command['result']['signal'] is None
    for stream in ['stdout', 'stderr']:
        path = NATIVE / (command['label'] + '.' + stream + '.log')
        assert digest(path.read_bytes()) == command[stream + 'Sha256']
        assert path.read_text() == command['result'][stream]
        original = BASE / 'project6-pe-bounds-native.integration-f009' / path.name
        assert path.read_bytes() == original.read_bytes()
assert (NATIVE / 'native.json').read_bytes() == (BASE / 'project6-pe-bounds-native.integration-f009/native.json').read_bytes()
observed = load(NATIVE / 'observe-authored.stdout.log')['results']
assert len(observed) == 58 and len({row['id'] for row in observed}) == 58
for actual, row in zip(observed, native['authored']):
    assert actual['id'] == row['id'] and actual['observation'] == row['native']
for row in native['references']:
    assert row['native'] == load(NATIVE / ('observe-' + row['id'] + '.stdout.log'))
    assert row['comparison']['differences'] == []
    assert row['imageSha256'] == row['native']['image']['sha256']
    assert row['imageBytes'] == row['native']['image']['bytes']

phase_receipts = []
for phase in ['native', 'verify-external', 'retain-native', 'verify-retained', 'focused', 'performance']:
    path = EXECUTION / (phase + '.execution.json')
    row = load(path)
    assert row['status'] == 'passed' and row['exitCode'] == 0 and row['signal'] is None
    assert row['sourcesUnchanged'] and not row['inspectionErrors'] and not row['interruptions']
    for output in row['outputs']:
        actual = identity(Path(output['path']))
        assert actual == output
    phase_receipts.append({**identity(path), 'startedUtc': row['startedUtc'], 'finishedUtc': row['finishedUtc'],
                           'sourceHead': row['sourceBefore']['head'], 'status': row['status']})
focused_text = (EXECUTION / 'focused.stdout.txt').read_text()
for line in ['ℹ tests 91', 'ℹ pass 91', 'ℹ fail 0', 'ℹ cancelled 0', 'ℹ skipped 0', 'ℹ todo 0']:
    assert line in focused_text
stderr = (EXECUTION / 'performance.stderr.txt').read_bytes()
assert stderr == b''
preflight_path = BASE / 'project6-pe-bounds-performance-integration-ddf3-preflight.json'
preflight = load(preflight_path)
assert digest(preflight_path.read_bytes()) == '8229888ace6c1f104ba10f8bf9ca56b34fd5caa52f7d2167467582d4073abfe5'
assert preflight['admitted'] and preflight['processCandidates'] == []
assert preflight['candidate']['head'] == HEAD and preflight['baseline']['head'] == BASELINE
assert preflight['candidate']['status'] == preflight['baseline']['status'] == ''
assert len(preflight['aliases']) == 12 and all(row['owned'] for row in preflight['aliases'])
assert preflight['freeBytes'] == 498348032 and preflight['freeBytes'] >= preflight['requiredBytes']
for row in preflight['files']:
    assert identity(Path(row['path'])) == row
for row in preflight['aliases']:
    assert str(Path(row['path']).resolve()) == row['target']
assert preflight['utc'] <= receipt['startedUtc'] <= report['startedAt'].replace('Z', '+00:00')
plan = load(CANDIDATE / 'tests/fixtures/pe-bounds/validation-plan-integration-f009.json')
assert receipt['argv'] == plan['performance']
assert receipt['expectedHead'] == HEAD
assert digest((CANDIDATE / plan['integration']['recorder']).read_bytes()) == receipt['recorderSha256']
assert digest((CANDIDATE / 'tests/fixtures/pe-bounds/validation-plan-integration-f009.json').read_bytes()) == receipt['planSha256']
assert report['protocol']['warmupBatches'] == 20 and report['protocol']['measuredBatches'] == 100
assert report['protocol']['workloads'] == [{'id': name, 'operations': operations} for name, operations in workloads]
assert report['performanceAcceptance'] == 'pending independent review'
policy = load(CANDIDATE / 'scripts/conformance/static/allowlist.json')
worker_path = 'packages/cil/tools/pe-bounds-benchmark-worker.mjs'
authorities = [row for row in policy['allow'] if row['path'] == worker_path and row['operation'] == 'dynamic-import']
assert len(authorities) == 1 and authorities[0]['count'] == 1 and authorities[0]['sha256'] == report['tools'][worker_path]
for source, expected in [(report['sources']['baseline'], BASELINE), (report['sources']['candidate'], PRODUCT)]:
    assert source['productCommit'] == expected
heap_comparisons = []
for name, operations in workloads:
    before, after = heap[name + '-baseline'], heap[name + '-candidate']
    heap_comparisons.append({'workload': name, 'operationsPerBatch': operations,
        'measuredBatchNetBytes': {metric: {'baseline': before['measuredBatchNetBytes'][metric],
            'candidate': after['measuredBatchNetBytes'][metric],
            'signedDeltaBytesPerBatch': after['measuredBatchNetBytes'][metric] - before['measuredBatchNetBytes'][metric]}
            for metric in ['median', 'p95', 'p99', 'min', 'max']},
        'meanMeasuredNetBytesDelta': after['meanMeasuredNetBytes'] - before['meanMeasuredNetBytes'],
        'sumMeasuredNetBytesDelta': after['sumMeasuredNetBytes'] - before['sumMeasuredNetBytes']})
manifest = [identity(path) for path in sorted(DATA.iterdir()) if path.is_file()]
assert len(manifest) == 52 and sum(row['bytes'] for row in manifest) == 4265710
output = {
    'schemaVersion': 1, 'reviewedAt': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'Independent retained-data arithmetic, hash, source and chronology review; no product imports or qualification execution.',
    'reviewerSource': identity(Path(__file__)), 'candidate': HEAD, 'baseline': BASELINE, 'product': PRODUCT,
    'nativeSource': QUALIFIED, 'report': identity(DATA / 'report.json'), 'outerReceipt': identity(EXECUTION / 'performance.execution.json'),
    'environment': report['environment'], 'preflight': identity(preflight_path), 'processOrder': process_order, 'comparisons': comparisons,
    'heapComparisons': heap_comparisons,
    'allAdverseStatistics': adverse, 'heapObservations': heap, 'sourceFileCounts': source_file_counts,
    'counts': {'serialChildren': 12, 'preparationChildren': 2, 'measurementChildren': 10, 'measuredBatches': 1000,
               'warmupBatches': 200, 'chronologicalRows': 1200, 'timedCallsWithPassingGuards': 65760,
               'measuredCalls': 54800, 'warmupCalls': 10960, 'untimedWorkerPreflightReads': 60,
               'nativeAuthoredCases': 58, 'nativeReferenceImages': 3, 'focusedTestsPassed': 91,
               'outerSourceFilesVerified': len(receipt['sourceAfter']['files']), 'toolHashesVerified': len(report['tools']),
               'nativeSourceFilesVerified': len(native['sourceSha256'])},
    'nativeRelations': dict(Counter(row['relation'] for row in native['authored'])),
    'nativeProductStatus': dict(Counter(row['product']['status'] for row in native['authored'])),
    'nativeMetadataStatus': dict(Counter('accepted' if row['native']['metadata'] else 'rejected' for row in native['authored'])),
    'nativeCapture': identity(NATIVE / 'native.json'), 'phaseReceipts': phase_receipts,
    'stderr': {**identity(EXECUTION / 'performance.stderr.txt'), 'text': stderr.decode(),
               'explanation': 'Outer and all twelve child stderr files are empty; no queue notification was recorded.'},
    'manifest': manifest, 'rawFileCount': len(manifest), 'rawBytes': sum(row['bytes'] for row in manifest),
    'validation': 'All recomputed distributions, percent changes, chronologies, result/job/log hashes, source/tool/input hashes and retained-native links matched.',
    'sourceAssessment': [
        'Timed path is public readPE plus storing references; guards, input construction, imports, source identity and statistics are outside timing.',
        'Each read adds bounded header range checks and two interval arrays/sorts over at most 96 sections; RVA queries add no arrays or sort.',
        'Added checked ranges and two bounded interval arrays/sorts are on the timed read path; no measured attribution isolates their cost from other effects. No product edit or rerun was made, and causation is not established.',
        'Full reader data snapshots, borrowed input identity, metadata module name and section offset queries are guarded; method-body callback execution is not timed or independently covered by this benchmark.',
    ],
    'recommendedDisposition': 'Root must explicitly assess all quantified regressions, including the small/dense median costs and adverse tails. No threshold pass, exception, sign-off or human approval is recorded by this review.',
    'limitations': [
        'One fixed cohort on a shared host after a team quiet pause and a no-competing-process preflight; the host is not isolated. Favorable values are observations, not an established speedup cause or significance result.',
        'Percentiles describe batch means in microseconds per operation, not individual-call latency.',
        'All adverse min/max observations are retained in addition to median/p95/p99; no sample filtering or rerun.',
        'Signed net heap deltas are neither allocations nor peak memory and cannot establish GC causation.',
        'Native acceptance differences are retained as product policy distinctions, not rewritten as parity.',
        'Only read-only Git/data/source inspection and this standalone arithmetic review ran; no tests, imports, capture, benchmark, refs or worktree edits.',
    ],
}
destination = BASE / 'project6-pe-bounds-integration-independent-review.json'
with destination.open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(output, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'review': identity(destination), 'rawFileCount': len(manifest), 'rawBytes': output['rawBytes'],
                  'counts': output['counts'], 'comparisons': comparisons, 'allAdverseStatistics': adverse}, indent=2))
